topic: The co-founder of Apple alongside Steve Jobs
core_question: Who co-founded Apple Computer together with Steve Jobs in 1976?
answer_summary: Accept 'Steve Wozniak' — engineer who co-founded Apple with Steve Jobs (and Ronald Wayne) in 1976.
persona: skeptical and testy; using casual slang
